newsitem.title: USA: Baker hails Deng for moving China into modern age.
newsitem.headline: Baker hails Deng for moving China into modern age.

text.p: Former U.S. Secretary of State James Baker on Wednesday hailed the late Deng Xiaoping for embracing economic reforms in China and improving ties between Beijing and the United States.

"Deng Xiaoping's embrace of free-market, free-enterprise economic reforms moved China vigorously into the modern age," Baker, Secretary of State under President George Bush from 1989 to 1992, said in a statement.

"His legacy is also one of improved relations with the United States. Both before he assumed the helm of the ship of state and during his tenure there, Deng was a driving force in the process of normalisation," Baker added.
